1d2b22c0-6897-45ff-8879-08dadbac15d0.description: Deposits made for tenders, contracts, or as security, refundable upon fulfillment of conditions.

ad1ac9ae-b8d7-4298-9c0b-8c9553dc9df1.description: Receivables or credits due from government departments or agencies.

11af1f3e-3eb8-4af6-bb6b-9726cbfdc0bf.description: Payments made to vendors for goods or services yet to be received.

cec2b69b-ca47-4056-8c32-795e6bd239f0.description: Residual category for miscellaneous items not classified elsewhere.

d6a9d320-0215-4ee3-93e3-8bef46da4efc.description: Cumulative total of all other current assets categories.

7641c147-a67b-4d72-9b29-7efacaa921a6.name: Total Current Assets (a)
7641c147-a67b-4d72-9b29-7efacaa921a6.description: Represents the sum of all current assets, including inventories, trade debtors, cash and bank balances, and other current assets. This is the total value of assets expected to be converted to cash within a year.

d7c05039-0422-4b3f-999e-236e2b5a6b42.name: FIXED ASSETS
d7c05039-0422-4b3f-999e-236e2b5a6b42.description: Long-term tangible assets used in business operations that are not expected to be converted into cash in the current financial year, such as land, buildings, and machinery. Also known as Property, Plant, and Equipment (PP&E).

541c77ba-46c1-460a-bc3c-cb1fe88d78fd.name: Land & Buildings
541c77ba-46c1-460a-bc3c-cb1fe88d78fd.description: The value of immovable property, including land and physical structures like offices or factories, owned by the company.

161793ed-136b-487f-baf6-33147649d8ab.name: Plant & Machinery
161793ed-136b-487f-baf6-33147649d8ab.description: The value of equipment, machinery, and apparatus used in the company's production or operational processes

f1de9ecf-f7b6-4356-b78f-aa899f354dc1.name: Sundries
f1de9ecf-f7b6-4356-b78f-aa899f354dc1.description: Miscellaneous small-value fixed assets that do not fit into other specific categories, such as furniture, fixtures, and office equipment.

e0d4775c-78f2-4a06-909c-b347a618000f.name: Gross Fixed Assets
e0d4775c-78f2-4a06-909c-b347a618000f.description: The total original cost or acquisition value of all fixed assets before deducting accumulated depreciation.

312447b4-10a8-4637-82a2-38adb49b4cf9.name: Less: Depreciation to date
312447b4-10a8-4637-82a2-38adb49b4cf9.description: The cumulative amount of depreciation charged on fixed assets from the date of acquisition up to the current date.

5be6efdd-c4e7-4b14-803e-0bac8200e3bc.name: Net Fixed Assets
5be6efdd-c4e7-4b14-803e-0bac8200e3bc.description: The book value of fixed assets, calculated as Gross Fixed Assets minus accumulated depreciation. It represents the remaining value of assets.

a8fbc927-42f0-44a0-9fae-66ec5ce392e7.name: Capital Work in Progress
a8fbc927-42f0-44a0-9fae-66ec5ce392e7.description: Costs incurred for fixed assets that are still under construction or installation and are not yet ready for their intended use at the balance sheet date.

bcc8ae2b-af04-4d17-97ed-26765ac00565.name: Total Fixed Assets (b)
bcc8ae2b-af04-4d17-97ed-26765ac00565.description: The sum of Net Fixed Assets and Capital Work in Progress, representing the total value of long-term operational assets on the balance sheet.

540a4367-482a-4da4-a50a-dbc8d68ea3ac.name: NON-CURRENT ASSETS
540a4367-482a-4da4-a50a-dbc8d68ea3ac.description: Assets that are not expected to be converted into cash within one year, including long-term investments, loans, and other non-liquid assets.

294a2827-4d80-4251-9e9c-fa5088ff13fe.name: Investments in/Loans to subsidiaries
294a2827-4d80-4251-9e9c-fa5088ff13fe.description: Long-term financial investments and loans provided to subsidiary or associate companies

7dbf0a27-2226-4cab-87b9-3397a9405139.name: Other Non Current Assets
7dbf0a27-2226-4cab-87b9-3397a9405139.description: Miscellaneous long-term assets that do not fall under fixed assets, investments, or other specific non-current categories

9100a792-7d14-4210-a7a3-6b4590c326fe.name: Investment in other companies
9100a792-7d14-4210-a7a3-6b4590c326fe.description: Long-term equity or debt investments held in companies that are not subsidiaries or associates

d8c305e0-1936-473c-a3f8-dcb83dfcc7df.name: Investment in Mutual Funds
d8c305e0-1936-473c-a3f8-dcb83dfcc7df.description: Long-term investments made in various mutual fund schemes, not intended for short-term trading

0734f30e-4d98-4d2a-9b25-66b71f501605.name: Loans and Advances
0734f30e-4d98-4d2a-9b25-66b71f501605.description: Amounts lent or advanced to employees, subsidiaries, or others recoverable within a year.

363530b9-2e41-4f7f-9960-41eff9e6f79c.name: Overdue debtors
363530b9-2e41-4f7f-9960-41eff9e6f79c.description: Trade receivables that are past their due date for a significant period and are doubtful of collection within the next operating cycle.

4e0aa453-c243-40c7-b3da-609817c68245.name: Deposits with EB, etc.
4e0aa453-c243-40c7-b3da-609817c68245.description: Long-term security deposits made with utility providers like electricity boards, telephone companies, or other service providers.

6d1f4e01-94af-45de-8864-53028ad9c6fb.name: Non-Moving Inventories
6d1f4e01-94af-45de-8864-53028ad9c6fb.description: Inventory items that have not been sold or used in production for a prolonged period and are considered obsolete or slow-moving.

8fc655f6-dae3-4faa-907f-6e7fa4149cbb.name: Others
8fc655f6-dae3-4faa-907f-6e7fa4149cbb.description: Residual category for miscellaneous items not classified elsewhere.

78edd408-52ea-4999-8ad1-ec4176de3b91.name: Total Other Non Current Assets (c)
78edd408-52ea-4999-8ad1-ec4176de3b91.description: The aggregate value of all non-current assets excluding fixed assets, representing long-term investments and other long-term holdings.

69f2535c-f8e2-4322-b176-06659793d688.name: Deferred Tax Asset (d)
69f2535c-f8e2-4322-b176-06659793d688.description: An asset on the balance sheet that may be used to reduce any subsequent tax liability, arising from timing differences between accounting income and taxable income.

2ecf2cfc-f4c8-4bda-b847-47ded785fb74.name: INTANGIBLE ASSETS/MISC EXPENDITURE (e)
2ecf2cfc-f4c8-4bda-b847-47ded785fb74.description: Non-physical assets such as goodwill, patents, and trademarks, along with preliminary or deferred revenue expenditures yet to be written off to the profit and loss account.

76d37656-750c-4be5-9876-bcf59375b77f.name: TOTAL ASSETS (a+b+c+d+e)
76d37656-750c-4be5-9876-bcf59375b77f.description: The grand total of all company assets, including current, fixed, non-current, and intangible assets. This value must equal Total Liabilities.

6a3b36cc-83e0-42d7-9e9d-da68ebc84703.description: Short-term loans and credit facilities obtained from banks or financial institutions to finance the day-to-day operations of the business.

f3fbcb1f-b783-4c0e-bbbb-d5792c2b3a7f.description: Working capital loans or facilities availed from the bank to which this financial statement is being submitted for assessment.

e3b12f76-a88a-4d00-8d4e-20baf92196f1.description: Working capital loans or facilities availed from banks and financial institutions other than the primary applicant bank.

cd2b1bd4-f002-486a-8b24-8ca7f61f9ba6.description: Unsecured, short-term debt instruments issued by the company to raise funds for working capital requirements

926b1a21-689d-466f-932c-a272acb63d2a.description: The sum of all short-term borrowings from various banks and financial instruments for working capital purposes.

9d65b2c2-5d57-410f-b67c-1f5c4ab51b77.name: Creditors for Purchases
9d65b2c2-5d57-410f-b67c-1f5c4ab51b77.description: Amount owed to suppliers for goods or materials purchased on credit. Also known as Sundry Creditors or Trade Payables.

97963ff5-9cf4-486f-8356-b4e5b7a31ef1.name: Other Current Liabilities
97963ff5-9cf4-486f-8356-b4e5b7a31ef1.description: Short-term financial obligations other than bank borrowings and trade creditors, due within one year.

80f736e4-865c-41b4-aeb1-9c7042eff4b2.name: Creditors for Expenses
80f736e4-865c-41b4-aeb1-9c7042eff4b2.description: Amount owed for expenses incurred but not yet paid, such as rent, utilities, or professional fees.

18876dfa-4984-4b08-821c-e883b06ed5cb.name: Provision for Tax
18876dfa-4984-4b08-821c-e883b06ed5cb.description: An amount set aside from profits to cover the company's estimated income tax liability for the reporting period.

5daab6b6-6461-4d79-a4af-bf04c76fa3e4.description: The portion of long-term loans (like term loans or debentures) that is scheduled to be repaid within the next 12 months.

df66302b-273b-41cd-905e-a7f191e60529.description: Payments received from customers in advance for goods or services that are yet to be delivered or rendered.

4b137dca-315b-4877-b296-feef52536fe7.description: A residual category for any other short-term liabilities or provisions not classified under specific heads.

929db481-32ab-4b2d-ae6d-0c8aa47e9f70.description: The sum of all current liabilities excluding bank borrowings, including creditors, provisions, and other short-term obligations.

b1072652-efa9-47c6-b792-b7527fe08165.description: Amount owed to suppliers for the purchase of fixed assets or capital goods on a credit basis.

5a6646cd-fc42-47ba-8b99-6a4229ac35fb.description: The sum of all short-term obligations of the company, including working capital borrowings and other current liabilities, due within one year.

2d6411e3-b9a1-4c69-a288-05eddc845b02.description: Financial obligations that are not due for payment within one year, such as long-term bank loans, debentures, and deferred payments.

7aa8dc92-6f43-4026-8192-731a69e2d460.description: Any other long-term financial obligations not specifically classified under term loans, debentures, or other major heads

9359613d-3ad1-482b-aaa0-bd54b994fa99.description: Funds raised by the company from the public or other entities in the form of deposits for a fixed term.

e92b480d-64fe-480d-94ce-050e5e38de30.name: Foreign currency loans
e92b480d-64fe-480d-94ce-050e5e38de30.description: Long-term loans taken from foreign entities or in a currency other than the Indian Rupee.

a3089c59-29e6-4092-be46-3bb36ba75e17.description: The sum of all long-term financial obligations, including term loans, debentures, and other non-current liabilities.

aac7c840-05ff-4310-b80b-eb9b95fc8010.name: CAPITAL AND SURPLUS
aac7c840-05ff-4310-b80b-eb9b95fc8010.description: Represents the owners' stake in the company, comprising paid-up share capital and accumulated profits or reserves. Also known as Net Worth or Shareholders' Funds.

14489580-148e-449b-a223-fd572b7f8442.name: Paid up Capital
14489580-148e-449b-a223-fd572b7f8442.description: The total amount of money the company has received from shareholders in exchange for shares of its stock.

43745f53-e095-4753-8691-2a1cf757e6bf.name: Preference Share Capital
43745f53-e095-4753-8691-2a1cf757e6bf.description: Capital raised through the issue of preference shares, which carry a fixed dividend rate and have priority over equity shares in payment

b5f969b6-5a91-47a1-b76c-7973996a1669.name: Reserves and Surplus
b5f969b6-5a91-47a1-b76c-7973996a1669.description: The accumulated profits of the company that have been retained and not distributed as dividends, including general reserves and profit and loss account balances.

39a91a30-8c22-4ebc-b068-f2c90bf081d2.name: Revaluation Reserves
39a91a30-8c22-4ebc-b068-f2c90bf081d2.description: A reserve created when an asset is revalued to its fair market value, representing the unrealized gain on the asset

157aa074-a507-4f1d-a690-2db10002a74b.name: Loss Bought Forward
157aa074-a507-4f1d-a690-2db10002a74b.description: Accumulated losses from previous financial years that are carried forward to be offset against future profits.

74f90910-49bd-4ba9-b71f-f2c872481b33.name: Capital & Reserves (g)
74f90910-49bd-4ba9-b71f-f2c872481b33.description: The total shareholders' equity, calculated as the sum of paid-up capital and all reserves and surplus, less any accumulated losses.

27fe745b-ce39-469e-bfae-f7a3acbdae85.name: Deferred Tax Liability (h)
27fe745b-ce39-469e-bfae-f7a3acbdae85.description: A liability on the balance sheet representing income taxes that are due in future periods, arising from timing differences between accounting income and taxable income.

8e5a78ec-8d38-4b7a-a6d5-fbb8ff9883cc.name: TOTAL LIABILITIES (e+f+g+h)
